data.name: Bergstein
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Germanic elements ‘berg’ (mountain) and ‘stein’ (stone). The name Bergstein translates to ‘mountain stone’ or ‘stone from the mountain’. This name was traditionally given to children born in mountainous regions or to those who demonstrated strength and resilience, much like the mountains themselves.
